def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    # Только позиции, купленные до seed_time
    work = order_items[(order_items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids)) &
                       (order_items['ts'] < seed_time)].copy()

    result = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'))

    # ---------- Базовые агрегаты за всё время ----------
    if len(work) > 0:
        total_grp = work.groupby('product_id').agg(
            orders_total=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            units_total=('order_item_id', 'count'),
            price_total=('price', 'sum'),
            freight_total=('freight_value', 'sum'),
            price_avg=('price', 'mean'),
            freight_avg=('freight_value', 'mean'),
            price_max=('price', 'max'),
            price_min=('price', 'min'),
            price_std=('price', 'std'),
        )
        # Давность последней и первой продажи
        last_sale = work.groupby('product_id')['ts'].max()
        first_sale = work.groupby('product_id')['ts'].min()
        total_grp['days_since_last_sale'] = (seed_time - last_sale).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        total_grp['days_since_first_sale'] = (seed_time - first_sale).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        # Средний интервал между продажами
        span = total_grp['days_since_first_sale'] - total_grp['days_since_last_sale']
        total_grp['sale_interval_avg'] = span / total_grp['units_total'].clip(lower=1)
        total_grp = total_grp.drop(columns=[])
        for col in total_grp.columns:
            result[col] = total_grp[col].reindex(entity_ids)

    # ---------- Временные окна ----------
    windows = [7, 30, 90, 180, 365]
    for w in windows:
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=w)
        work_w = work[work['ts'] >= cutoff]
        if len(work_w) > 0:
            grp_w = work_w.groupby('product_id').agg(
                orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
                items=('order_item_id', 'count'),
                price=('price', 'sum'),
                freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
                price_mean=('price', 'mean'),
                sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
            )
            grp_w.columns = [f'{c}_{w}d' for c in grp_w.columns]
            for col in grp_w.columns:
                result[col] = grp_w[col].reindex(entity_ids)
        else:
            for col in [f'orders_{w}d', f'items_{w}d', f'price_{w}d',
                        f'freight_{w}d', f'price_mean_{w}d', f'sellers_{w}d']:
                result[col] = np.nan

    # Тренд: продажи последних 30 дней vs предыдущих 30 дней
    c30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    c60 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=60)
    recent = work[work['ts'] >= c30].groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
    prev = work[(work['ts'] < c30) & (work['ts'] >= c60)].groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
    result['orders_30d'] = recent.reindex(entity_ids)
    result['orders_prev30d'] = prev.reindex(entity_ids)
    result['orders_trend_30d'] = result['orders_30d'].fillna(0) - result['orders_prev30d'].fillna(0)

    # ---------- Отзывы (только те, что уже созданы к seed_time) ----------
    rev = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time][['order_id', 'review_score']]
    if len(work) > 0 and len(rev) > 0:
        wr = work.merge(rev, on='order_id', how='inner')
        if len(wr) > 0:
            rev_grp = wr.groupby('product_id').agg(
                review_avg=('review_score', 'mean'),
                review_cnt=('review_score', 'count'),
                review_min=('review_score', 'min'),
                review_max=('review_score', 'max'),
                review_std=('review_score', 'std'),
            )
            # Доля плохих отзывов
            bad = wr[wr['review_score'] <= 2].groupby('product_id')['review_score'].count()
            rev_grp['review_bad_share'] = bad.reindex(rev_grp.index).fillna(0) / rev_grp['review_cnt']
            for col in rev_grp.columns:
                result[col] = rev_grp[col].reindex(entity_ids)

        # Отзывы за последние 90 дней
        rev90 = reviews[(reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time) &
                        (reviews['review_creation_date'] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90))][['order_id', 'review_score']]
        if len(rev90) > 0:
            wr90 = work.merge(rev90, on='order_id', how='inner')
            if len(wr90) > 0:
                r90 = wr90.groupby('product_id').agg(
                    review_avg_90d=('review_score', 'mean'),
                    review_cnt_90d=('review_score', 'count'),
                )
                for col in r90.columns:
                    result[col] = r90[col].reindex(entity_ids)

    for col in ['review_avg', 'review_cnt', 'review_min', 'review_max', 'review_std',
                'review_bad_share', 'review_avg_90d', 'review_cnt_90d']:
        if col not in result.columns:
            result[col] = np.nan

    # ---------- Платежи (только по заказам, совершённым до seed_time) ----------
    if len(work) > 0:
        valid_orders = work[['order_id']].drop_duplicates()
        pay = payments.merge(valid_orders, on='order_id', how='inner')
        # фильтр по времени платежа, если ts корректен
        pay = pay[pay['ts'] < seed_time]
        if len(pay) > 0:
            pay_grp = pay.groupby('order_id').agg(
                payment_total=('payment_value', 'sum'),
                installments_max=('payment_installments', 'max'),
            ).reset_index()
            wo = work.merge(pay_grp, on='order_id', how='left')
            p = wo.groupby('product_id').agg(
                payment_total_avg=('payment_total', 'mean'),
                installments_max_avg=('installments_max', 'mean'),
            )
            for col in p.columns:
                result[col] = p[col].reindex(entity_ids)

    for col in ['payment_total_avg', 'installments_max_avg']:
        if col not in result.columns:
            result[col] = np.nan

    # ---------- Признаки доставки (только доставленные до seed_time) ----------
    if len(work) > 0:
        delivered = orders[(orders['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna()) &
                           (orders['order_delivered_customer_date'] < seed_time)][
            ['order_id', 'order_delivered_customer_date', 'order_purchase_timestamp',
             'order_estimated_delivery_date']]
        wd = work.merge(delivered, on='order_id', how='inner')
        if len(wd) > 0:
            wd['delivery_days'] = (wd['order_delivered_customer_date'] - wd['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
            wd['delay_days'] = (wd['order_delivered_customer_date'] - wd['order_estimated_delivery_date']).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
            d = wd.groupby('product_id').agg(
                delivery_days_avg=('delivery_days', 'mean'),
                delay_days_avg=('delay_days', 'mean'),
                delivered_cnt=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            )
            for col in d.columns:
                result[col] = d[col].reindex(entity_ids)

    for col in ['delivery_days_avg', 'delay_days_avg', 'delivered_cnt']:
        if col not in result.columns:
            result[col] = np.nan

    # Числовые признаки, заполнение пропусков
    result = result.reindex(entity_ids)
    result = result.fillna(0).astype(float)
    return result
